services.desc: Step beyond the classroom and immerse yourself in the performing arts with special ticket pricing designed for high school and college students. Experience world-class performances without breaking the bank! High school and college students with a valid and current student ID can enjoy select MPAC Presents performances for just $25 per ticket. Look for Student Pricing Available on your desired MPAC Presents show. Student tickets become available Monday, three weeks prior to the performance date.
